_schema_notes: One flat, cross-position ranking. Score = RHOF Custom Score, computed per role straight from each player's stats object (no WAR inputs). Hitters: (avg - replacementAvg) * AB + hrBonus * hr, where AB = hits / avg. Pitchers: (replacementEra - era) * inningsPerDecision * (wins + losses) + soBonus * so + decisionBonus * (wins - losses). No positional averaging, no induction status -- rank is purely earned by the formula. Regenerate this file from Lahman by computing career avg/hits/hr (hitters) or wins/losses/era/so (pitchers) per player and keeping these exact field names -- war/war7/war3 are no longer used.

formula.name: RHOF Custom Score
formula.description: Hitters earn value for batting above a replacement-level .230 average, scaled by career at-bats, plus a flat bonus per home run. Pitchers earn value for an ERA below a replacement-level 4.20, scaled by an innings estimate built from career decisions, plus bonuses for strikeouts and net wins. No WAR inputs -- everything comes straight from career hits/HR/AVG or W/L/ERA/SO.
